name: OUT_MED_ADHERE_INFO_HX
description: This table stores historical medication fill information for the patient. Each row represents a medication.

columns.name: REGISTRY_DATA_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the registry data record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: OUTCOME_KEY_MED_ADH_HX
columns.description: The unique outcome key that links medication data to the rest of the outcome data.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_NAME_HX
columns.description: The medication name relevant to an adherence measure.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_HX_NDC_ID
columns.description: The networked NDC record ID.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_HX_NDC_ID_NDC_CODE
columns.description: The external code for the National Drug Code (NDC). An NDC represents packages of medications.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_FIRST_FILL_HX_DATE
columns.description: The date this medication was first filled.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_LAST_FILL_HX_DATE
columns.description: The most recent fill date for the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_NEXT_FILL_HX_DATE
columns.description: The expected next fill date for the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_DAYS_SUPPLY_HX
columns.description: The number of days that the latest medication fill should last if taken as prescribed.

columns.name: OUT_HX_MED_ELIG_EXT_DAY_SUP_C_NAME
columns.description: Whether the patient is eligible for a larger medication supply.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_REFILLS_REMAIN_HX
columns.description: The number of refills a patient can obtain before their provider must authorize more.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PRESCRIBER_NAME_HX
columns.description: The name of the provider who prescribed the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PRESCRIBER_NPI_HX
columns.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the provider who prescribed the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PRESCRIBER_PH_HX
columns.description: The phone number of the provider who prescribed the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PHARMACY_NAME_HX
columns.description: The name of the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PHARMACY_NPI_HX
columns.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PHARMACY_PHONE_HX
columns.description: The phone number of the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_HX_MED_PHARMACY_SRC_C_NAME
columns.description: The method of distribution used by the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication.

columns.name: OUTCOME_MED_PREF_PHARM_HX_YN
columns.description: Whether the pharmacy where the patient obtained the medication is a preferred pharmacy for the payer. Patients often have lower out-of-pocket costs at preferred pharmacies.
